## RSA ID Plus Admin Logs Dashboard
---

This workbook gives identity and security teams one place to monitor administrator activity in RSA ID Plus, ingested into Microsoft Sentinel through the RSA ID Plus Admin Logs connector. It shows how many administrator events are arriving, how sign-ins succeed and fail, which source IP addresses generate failures, and when admin accounts are locked and unlocked, so analysts can spot suspicious administrator access quickly.

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| summarize Events = count()
content.title: Total Events

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| summarize FailedSignIns = countif(activityKey == "SIGNIN_FAILURE")
content.title: Failed Sign-ins

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| summarize Lockouts = countif(activityKey == "LOCKED_ADMIN_ACCOUNT")
content.title: Admin Lockouts

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| summarize Events = count() by activityKey
content.title: Events by Activity

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| summarize Events = count() by activityKey, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Events Over Time by Activity

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| where activityKey in ("SIGNIN_SUCCESS", "SIGNIN_FAILURE")
| extend Outcome = iff(activityKey == "SIGNIN_SUCCESS", "Success", "Failure")
| summarize Events = count() by Outcome
content.title: Sign-in Outcomes

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| where activityKey in ("SIGNIN_SUCCESS", "SIGNIN_FAILURE")
| summarize SignIns = count(), Failures = countif(activityKey == "SIGNIN_FAILURE") by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend FailureRatePercent = round(100.0 * Failures / SignIns, 1)
| project TimeGenerated, FailureRatePercent
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Sign-in Failure Rate by Day

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| summarize SignInSuccess = countif(activityKey == "SIGNIN_SUCCESS"), SignInFailure = countif(activityKey == "SIGNIN_FAILURE"), SignOut = countif(activityKey == "SIGNOUT"), LastActivity = max(TimeGenerated) by adminUserName
| order by SignInFailure desc
content.title: Sign-in Activity by Admin

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| where activityKey == "SIGNIN_FAILURE"
| summarize FailedSignIns = count() by sourceIPAddress
| top 10 by FailedSignIns desc
content.title: Failed Sign-ins by Source IP

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| where activityKey == "SIGNIN_FAILURE"
| extend Reason = extract(@"Reason: (.*)$", 1, message)
| extend Reason = iff(isempty(Reason), "Not specified", Reason)
| summarize FailedSignIns = count() by Reason
| order by FailedSignIns desc
content.title: Failed Sign-in Reasons

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| summarize Events = count(), Failures = countif(activityKey == "SIGNIN_FAILURE"), DistinctAdmins = dcount(adminUserName), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by sourceIPAddress
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Source IP Activity

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| where activityKey in ("LOCKED_ADMIN_ACCOUNT", "UNLOCK_ADMIN_USER")
| project TimeGenerated, Activity = activityKey, Admin = adminUserName, Role = adminUserRole, SourceIp = sourceIPAddress, Result = result, Message = message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Lockout and Unlock Events

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| summarize Events = count() by adminUserName
| order by Events desc
content.title: Events by Admin

content.query:
RSAIDPlusAdminLogsMock
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by eventId
| where adminUserName in ({AdminUser})
| project TimeGenerated, Admin = adminUserName, Role = adminUserRole, Activity = activityKey, Result = result, SourceIp = sourceIPAddress, Message = message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Latest Admin Events
